job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed mtp-p2h-fa-50b05596a-tc-b (ot_p2h_fadd16, RTL 50b05596a, snapshot of 4 drifted files): same RTL, outline 216.0x58.32, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-ds-mtp

benches.name: p2h_gate
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/ot_p2h_fadd16_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/ot_p2h_fadd16_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/mtp_p2_rootpipe_gate.py --out {RUN}/bench/gate
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 50b05596a snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/ot_p2h_fadd16_m5/src]
